name: Blessed Water
description: Water sanctified in a formal rite for warding and minor purification.
narrative_effects: Supports consecration, ward tracing, or cleansing narration against minor corruption.

mechanical_effect.trigger: applied, sprinkled, or used as part of a consecration, ward-tracing, or cleansing rite against minor corruption
mechanical_effect.applies_to: checks for minor purification, ward tracing, consecration, or cleansing narration where sacred authority is relevant
mechanical_effect.does_not_apply: major banishment or grave profane entities requiring stronger rites; mundane cleaning; situations with no sacred or corruptive element
